question: How far is the nearest attraction from Holiday Inn & Suites Joliet Southwest, Joliet, IL?
sql:
SELECT *, ST_Distance(geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-88.170817 41.495612)',4326)::geography)  AS distance  FROM pois
WHERE tourism = 'attraction'
ORDER BY geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-88.170817 41.495612)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: Holiday Inn & Suites Joliet Southwest, Joliet, IL
